recent: Southern Score Builders 近期获得两项合约：子公司 Southern Score Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 9 月 11 日接受 Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh 的授标函，价值 RM180 million；另于 2026 年 11 月获得 Port Dickson 数据中心电气分包合约，总值 RM146.8 million。公司也发布了 2026 财年年度报告，并将在 2026 年 12 月 3 日举行第 23 届常年股东大会。
notable: 子公司 Southern Score Sdn Bhd 接受 Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh 的授标函，价值 RM180 million，涉及 Melaka 的医院主楼工程。
子公司获得 Port Dickson 数据中心电气分包合约，总值 RM146.8 million。
董事兼首席执行官 Gan Yee Hin 于 2026 年 9 月 7 日和 9 日分别增持 6,670,000 股和 2,841,900 股，随后于 9 月 25 日减持 3,000,000 股。
risks: 董事兼首席执行官 Gan Yee Hin 于 2026 年 9 月 25 日减持 3,000,000 股。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM177.1 million，环比增长 32.5%，同比增长 118.5%；净利为 RM21.3 million，环比增长 7.8%，同比增长 82.6%；净利率为 12.0%，低于上一季度的 14.8%。

recent_en: Southern Score Builders recently secured two contracts: its subsidiary Southern Score Sdn Bhd accepted a letter of award from Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh worth RM180 million on 11 September 2026, and in November 2026 secured electrical subcontracts for data centres in Port Dickson totaling RM146.8 million.
notable_en: Subsidiary Southern Score Sdn Bhd accepted a letter of award from Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh worth RM180 million for main building works for a hospital in Melaka.
Subsidiary secured electrical subcontracts for data centres in Port Dickson totaling RM146.8 million.
Director and CEO Gan Yee Hin acquired 6,670,000 shares and 2,841,900 shares on 7 and 9 September 2026 respectively, and later disposed of 3,000,000 shares on 25 September.
risks_en: Director and CEO Gan Yee Hin disposed of 3,000,000 shares on 25 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the fourth quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM177.1 million, up 32.5% QoQ and 118.5% YoY; net profit was RM21.3 million, up 7.8% QoQ and 82.6% YoY; net margin was 12.0%, down from 14.8% in the previous quarter.
